subject.title: fix(agents): repair orphaned tool_use pairs on compaction prune path

question: Should compaction use the same aborted-turn drop policy as strict-provider replay, accepting small context loss instead of synthesizing a fake tool result?
rationale: The code path is a valid P1 session-state repair, but the final choice between dropping interrupted assistant tool-call turns and preserving them with synthetic results is a maintainer-owned session-state policy decision.

options.title: Accept drop-policy compaction repair
options.body: Approve this PR if compaction should match the existing strict-provider replay behavior by dropping aborted assistant tool-call turns before summarization.

options.title: Require synthetic-result preservation
options.body: Ask for a targeted rewrite if compaction must preserve interrupted turns with explicit synthetic results instead of dropping them.

options.title: Pause for broader recovery design
options.body: Leave the PR unmerged if maintainers want a larger aborted-turn recovery design before changing compaction behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept drop-policy compaction repair
